description: Return the full chain of values a key has held over time, newest first — each value, who wrote it, and which earlier assertion it superseded. Answers 'why does the agent still believe X?' and audits how a fact evolved. Bounded: returns a truncated flag when more exist. Costs 1 credit.

limit.description: Max results. Max 200. A truncated flag is returned when more exist.

name: get_assertion_history
